selection_policy.budget_rule: Use current VN numeric price as a hard ceiling only when min_vnd/max_vnd are populated. Otherwise budget_hint_vn is a soft signal only.
selection_policy.primary_use_rule: fit[primary_use] weighted strongest; editorial fit is 0–5 and is not an objective quality score.
selection_policy.result_rule: Return 3–5 strong candidates, cap repeated product family unless ecosystem choice makes repetition useful.
selection_policy.zero_result_rule: Never silently violate hard requirements. Show near-matches separately with explicit misses.
